parts.name: Articular disc proper
parts.attachment_or_location: spans from the sigmoid notch of the radius to the ulnar fovea/styloid, deep to the ulnocarpal ligaments
parts.function_note: the central load-bearing component; caps the distal ulna and completes the radiocarpal joint's articular surface even though the ulna itself does not directly contact the carpus.
parts.source: Palmer AK, Werner FW (1981) 'The triangular fibrocartilage complex of the wrist -- anatomy and function.' J Hand Surg Am 6(2):153-162 -- the original TFCC structural/functional description, including its articular disc and meniscus homologue components.

parts.name: Meniscus homologue
parts.attachment_or_location: ulnar peripheral margin, near the triquetrum
parts.function_note: a fibrous, more vascularized peripheral extension distinct from the central avascular disc proper -- the TFCC's central-vs-peripheral vascularity split (mirroring the knee menisci's zonal pattern) is clinically relevant to tear-healing potential.
parts.source: Palmer AK, Werner FW (1981) 'The triangular fibrocartilage complex of the wrist -- anatomy and function.' J Hand Surg Am 6(2):153-162 -- the original TFCC structural/functional description, including its articular disc and meniscus homologue components.; Bednar MS, Arnoczky SP, Weiland AJ (1991) 'The microvasculature of the triangular fibrocartilage complex: its clinical significance.' J Hand Surg Am 16(6):1101-1105 -- the actual source of the TFCC's central-avascular/peripheral-vascularized zonation (Palmer & Werner 1981, used elsewhere in this entity for the TFCC's general composition and DRUJ-stabilizing role, is a gross-anatomic/biomechanical dissection study that does not address vascular microanatomy -- caught by adversarial fact-check, see docs/VERIFICATION.md).

function: The wrist's principal ulnar-sided stabilizer and the main load-bearing/transmission structure across the distal radioulnar and ulnocarpal joints, working together with the ulnar collateral ligament of the wrist (data/ligaments/wrist_ligaments.json) as a single functional complex.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Palmer AK, Werner FW (1981) 'The triangular fibrocartilage complex of the wrist -- anatomy and function.' J Hand Surg Am 6(2):153-162 -- the original TFCC structural/functional description, including its articular disc and meniscus homologue components.
